title: Queue independent acceptance automatically once evidence settles (no manual next-turn request or evaluator-slot mail)
outcome: Queue independent acceptance automatically once evidence settles (no manual next-turn request or evaluator-slot mail)
acceptance: When an item's required evidence has settled, TermAl queues its independent acceptance evaluation itself. The author doesn't request it in a later turn, and nobody mails for an evaluator slot or manually recovers the spawn.

Independence, the evidence basis and the capacity limits are unchanged. A queued evaluation waiting for capacity reports PENDING with its release condition, and every refusal names its check, the observed values and a remedy.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree that lands.
